newsitem.title: USA: Kissimmee, Fla., mayor threatened with impeachment.
newsitem.headline: Kissimmee, Fla., mayor threatened with impeachment.

text.p: Kissimmee, Fla., Mayor John Pollet was given until 1600 EDT Friday to apologize for an alleged ethical violation or be impeached.

In an impeachment hearing Thursday, the city commission found that Pollet violated city ethics rules by soliciting and accepting free basketball playoff tickets from a firm that did business with the city.
But the council stopped short of approving an impeachment order. It gave Pollet the opportunity to admit guilt and apologize or be kicked out of office.
Pollet was not in his office Friday morning and city officials said they had not yet heard from him.
